description: Implementation of absl::time::clock functions, including high-resolution time retrieval, cycle counter-based timing, and sleep utilities, with platform-specific optimizations and internal synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: UnscaledCycleClockWrapperForGetCurrentTime
classes.description: Wrapper class providing static method Now() to access the cycle counter-based current time.

methods.name: Now
methods.description: Returns current time in nanoseconds using cycle counter or system call depending on compile-time flags.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeNanos
methods.description: Retrieves current time in nanoseconds, choosing between fast cycle counter-based method or system call.

methods.name: SleepOnce
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified duration, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: AbslInternalSleepFor
methods.description: Weak external C function that sleeps for a given duration, calling SleepOnce repeatedly.
